note: Corrections applied to src/eligibility/MSU_Eligibility_Rules.supplied.json to produce MSU_Eligibility_Rules.json. Only demonstrable transcription or implementation errors with unambiguous evidence in the approved January/February 2027 advert. Genuine ambiguities are not corrected here; they are handled in src/eligibility/rule_overrides.json as confirmation-required readings.
source: data/source_pdfs/MSU JANUARY FEBRUARY 2027 INTAKE ADVERT.pdf and the approved structured records MSU_2027_Intake_Corrected_v2.json

corrections.evidence: Faculty of Agriculture, Environment and Natural Resources Management faculty note: "('O' Level Maths required for all programmes)".
corrections.justification: The advert states the requirement for every programme of the faculty; the rule omitted it, so an applicant without O Level Mathematics could be shown as meeting the requirements.

corrections.old: 4 lines, the first split mid-sentence ('...including i.' / 'Mathematics, English and Combined Science...')
corrections.evidence: Advert record MSU-JF2027-133 entry_requirements (3 lines, 'i. Passed at least 5 subjects at Ordinary Level including Mathematics, English and Combined Science or equivalent. National Diploma ...').
corrections.justification: Transcription error: the text shown to applicants was garbled.

corrections.evidence: 'Passed at least 5 subjects at Ordinary Level including Mathematics, English and Combined Science or equivalent.'
corrections.justification: Omitted O Level subject named in the advert.

corrections.evidence: 'At least five 'O' Level passes or the equivalent, including English language, and an African language.'
corrections.justification: Omitted O Level requirement named in the advert. The checker cannot match a specific African language name to this requirement, so it is always reported as 'to confirm' (conservative).

corrections.evidence: p. 24 (MSU-JF2027-136): 'two Advanced level passes in any two of the following Science subjects Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Geography'; p. 1 lists Geography among preferred 'Sciences or Commercial subjects'.
corrections.justification: The advert itself classifies Geography as a science subject; the taxonomy did not, so applicants with Geography were rejected for 'any science' slots. Matches that rely on Geography as a generic science are still shown as conditional (rule_overrides.json), because the advert names it as a science only for some programmes.
